pkgmetadata.longdescription: librespot is an open source client library for Spotify that also acts as a Spotify Connect receiver: the device shows up in the official Spotify clients, which only steer playback, while the audio is fetched and decoded locally. Needs a Spotify Premium account.

use.flag: Announce the Spotify Connect receiver through avahi-daemon over D-Bus instead of the built-in mDNS responder
Enable the PulseAudio audio backend (also PipeWire's PulseAudio server)
Enable the Rodio audio backend (cpal, ALSA on Linux)
